title: Israel Did Evil Again
text: After Ehud died, the Israelites again did evil in the sight of the LORD.

title: Sold to Jabin
text: So the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor.

title: The Israelites Cried Out
text: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD …

title: Nine Hundred Chariots of Iron
text: … because Jabin had nine hundred chariots of iron, and he had harshly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years.

title: A Prophetess
text: Now Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was judging Israel at that time.

title: The Palm of Deborah
text: And she would sit under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim …

title: Up to Her for Judgment
text: … where the Israelites would go up to her for judgment.

title: The LORD Is Commanding You
text: Surely the LORD, the God of Israel, is commanding you …

title: Go to Mount Tabor
text: Go and march to Mount Tabor, taking with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun.

title: If You Will Go with Me
text: If you will go with me, I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.

title: No Honor on This Road
text: … but the road you are taking will bring you no honor, because the LORD will be selling Sisera into the hand of a woman.

title: To Kedesh
text: So Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh …

title: Ten Thousand Men Followed
text: Ten thousand men followed him, and Deborah also went with him.

title: Heber the Kenite
text: Now Heber the Kenite had moved away from the Kenites …

title: Sisera Was Told
text: When Sisera was told that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up Mount Tabor …

title: All Nine Hundred
text: … he summoned all nine hundred of his iron chariots …

title: Arise!
text: Arise, for this is the day that the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand.

title: Has Not the LORD Gone Before You?
text: Has not the LORD gone before you?

title: The Stars Fought
text: From the heavens the stars fought; from their courses they fought against Sisera.

title: The River Kishon
text: The River Kishon swept them away, the ancient river, the River Kishon.

title: The LORD Routed Them
text: And in front of him the LORD routed with the sword Sisera, all his charioteers, and all his army.

title: Fled on Foot
text: Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled on foot.

title: Jael's Tent
text: Meanwhile, Sisera had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite …

title: A Container of Milk
text: So she opened a container of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him again.

title: God Subdued Jabin
text: On that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan before the Israelites.

title: Deborah and Barak Sang
text: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:

title: When the People Volunteer
text: When the princes take the lead in Israel, when the people volunteer, bless the LORD.

title: Rest for Forty Years
text: And the land had rest for forty years.
